fusions.name: Staghorn Splinters
fusions.desc: Flings 3 branching splinters of staghorn coral at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Bounding Gore
fusions.desc: Bounds up to 6 tiles to an enemy and gores it with branching coral for 12 damage, up to 1.5 times as much from the full 6 tiles, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Startled Into Cover
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 5 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, you move 20% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Flinch and Harden
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
